description.value: Interior Whitewater Expeditions is Clearwater's most experienced rafting company, operating on the Clearwater River within Wells Gray Provincial Park since 1983. The company offers half-day and multi-day whitewater rafting trips ranging from family-friendly Class I-II floats to Class IV rapids. A touring cyclist based in Clearwater could use IWE for a memorable adventure day on the river without leaving the area.
